title: Runtime Locations
description: Schema for locations.yaml — where the harness reads and writes runtime data (analysis results, the portfolio graph, the metrics/progress tree, the workspace root, the feed cache) plus operator-provided source overrides. These are deployment/estate values, not engine knowledge: the engine receives them injected and never assumes a workspace topology. Each value is a local path or a location URI (file://, s3://, gs://, az://), or an https endpoint for source overrides. Local paths may be absolute or relative to the config home ($TRAUST_CONFIG_HOME); load_context() normalizes relatives to absolute. Every field is optional; a feature that needs an unset location fails loudly. Config-owned: there are no environment-variable overrides — edit this file.

workspace.description: Workspace root the harness reads source repos from.

analysis_results.description: Where findings-side artifacts live (graphs, findings.db, compliance, sweeps). A local path or file:// URI keeps them on disk; an object-store URI keeps them in a bucket: s3:// (traust-engine[s3]), gs:// or gcs:// (traust-engine[remote] plus gcsfs), az:// or abfs:// (traust-engine[remote] plus adlfs). Connection settings and credentials never go here; they come from the environment (the provider's standard credential chain, plus HARNESS_S3_* for S3-compatible stores). The bucket must enforce encryption at rest by its own policy (for example SSE-KMS default encryption): the harness writes security findings, some embargoed, and does not set encryption per object.

portfolio_graph.description: The portfolio graph DB location. Defaults to <analysis_results>/graph/portfolio-graph.db when unset.

rule_drafts.description: Rule-draft staging directory for sweep collect/draft and regression-rule drafting. Defaults to <progress_tracker>/metrics/rule-mining/rule-drafts when unset.

feeds_cache.description: Cache directory for fetched feed data.

gitleaks_config.description: Path to the gitleaks rules TOML used by the secret pre-scan adapter. Overrides the bundled default.

opengrep_rules.description: Directory of the opengrep rule pack. Overrides the bundled default.

product_definitions.description: Endpoint (URL) for the product/ownership registry that populates product-definitions. Deployment-specific; absent means the source is not fetched and its consumers degrade to null contacts.

sarif_tool_uri.description: informationUri stamped into exported SARIF driver blocks. Deployment-specific; omitted when unset so no internal host leaks into shared SARIF.
